text.style: font-size:25px;font-weight:600;font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif;line-height:1.2
text.tspan: Share of male vs. female employment in industry2025
The horizontal axis shows female employment in industry as a share of total female employment. The vertical
axis shows male employment in industry as a share of total male employment. The industry sector consists of
mining, manufacturing, construction, and public utilities.
Data source: ILO Modelled Estimates, via World Bank (2026)
Note: Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2020 and 2024 is shown instead.
